radius.$description: CLASSIFICATION: sm/md/lg/pill are DERIVED (generic rem scale, Stage 5). The `ref*` entries below are MEASURED - ported verbatim from the reference template's own radius set per CLIENT_REQ_012 / EV-20260826-032, ordered by frequency of use in its stylesheet.

refCard.$description: Dominant radius (14 uses) - cards, tinted sections, media panels.

refInner.$description: Secondary radius (10 uses) - nested elements inside a card, icon tiles.

refPill.$description: Pill/eyebrow (.sub-heading) and button capsules. Reference also uses 1000px interchangeably; both fully round, so one token covers them.

refCardAsymmetric.$description: Asymmetric corner treatment used on overlay/detail cards (e.g. .card-about-detail). Not decorative noise - it is what visually anchors an overlay card to the corner of its image.
